quests.title: The American Letter
quests.summary: Trace a famine emigrant through the records of Boston, then take on the councillor.

steps.text: Ask the Family Historian on Washington Street.
Read the passenger lists with the Archivist in the Irish Heritage Centre.
Ask the Parish Priest at St Stephen's, then return to the councillor.

quests.reward: An emigrant's claddagh ring (a Spirit charm), clam chowder and standing with Kin Abroad.
